utility.notes: American Canyon is a well-documented Napa County city within PG&E's core Northern California service territory.

value.name: MCE (Marin Clean Energy)
value.notes: MCE's own service-area page confirms American Canyon as one of 6 Napa County communities it serves (alongside Calistoga, Napa, St. Helena, Yountville, and unincorporated Napa County). PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

permit_authority.value: City of American Canyon Community Development Department, Building Division

permit_url.notes: The city's Streamlined Residential Rooftop Solar Energy Permit ordinance (Chapter 16.15); a dedicated city-hosted solar permit landing page was not located this session.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes American Canyon/Napa County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value: Only one inspection is required and performed by the building division for small residential rooftop solar energy systems eligible for expedited review

value.notes: Typical approval time for solar panel permits in American Canyon is 3 business days.

value.program_or_pathway: Streamlined Residential Rooftop Solar Energy Permit (AB 2188 / Solar Rights Act compliant)
other_conditions: The city reviews submitted plans for building code compliance, structural integrity, fire safety, energy code, and ADA accessibility
Larger rooftop systems (10kW and above) require standard building and electrical permits with full plan review
Ground-mounted arrays require a building permit, electrical permit, and zoning review as accessory structures
